attempts.reasoning: Added in-flight deduplication to TtlCache.getOrLoad. A separate inFlight Map stores the promise for each key currently loading. Concurrent callers for the same key return the same promise so loader is invoked once. The promise is created via an async IIFE that awaits loader, stores via set on success, and deletes the inFlight entry in finally so rejections are not cached and next call retries. get/has/size continue to reflect only entries, never promises. TTL and maxSize logic unchanged and different keys use independent entries.
